is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. mosquitoes (page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (referred to as L1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (referred to as G119S) (page 1, 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides genotype counts (LL, LF, FF for kdr; GG, GS, SS for Ace-1) for alive and dead mosquitoes for each insecticide tested (page 3).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Tiassalé, Côte d’Ivoire (page 1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and genotyping data (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the location as Tiassalé, southern Côte d’Ivoire (5°52′47′′N; 4°49′48′′W) (page 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study specifies the collection period as May–September 2011 (page 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific, original collection of 1,571 mosquitoes in 2011.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables (Table 1 and Table 2).

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.s. (M form) from Tiassalé, Côte d’Ivoire, collected in 2011. The researchers performed WHO bioassays for five insecticides and genotyped a subset of mosquitoes for kdr (L1014F) and Ace-1 (G119S) mutations, finding high frequencies of both and significant associations between genotypes and survival.
